verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. God, the one I praise, do not stay silent.
Wicked people and liars have opened their mouths against me. They have spoken lies about me.
They surround me with words of hatred. They attack me for no reason.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I keep praying.
They pay me back evil for good and hatred for my love.
They say, "Appoint a wicked person to judge him. Let an accuser stand at his right side.
When he is put on trial, let him be found guilty. Let even his prayers be counted as sin.
Let his life be short. Let someone else take his position.
Let his children lose their father, and his wife become a widow.
Let his children wander around begging. Let them be driven from their ruined homes.
Let the people he owes money to take everything he has. Let strangers steal everything he worked for.
Let no one be kind to him or feel sorry for his children who have no father.
Let his family line come to an end. Let their names be wiped out in the next generation.
Let the LORD remember the sins of his ancestors. Do not let the sin of his mother be wiped away.
Let the LORD always keep their sins in mind, so he may wipe out any memory of them from the earth."
For he never thought of being kind. He chased the poor, the needy, and those with broken hearts to kill them.
He loved to curse others, so let curses come back on him. He never wanted to bless others, so let blessings be far from him.
He wore cursing like his clothes. Let it soak into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
Let it be like a robe wrapped around him, like a belt he always wears.
May this be how the LORD pays back my accusers, those who speak evil against me.
But you, GOD the Lord, help me for the honour of your name. Rescue me because your faithful love is good.
I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded deep inside me.
I am fading away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
My knees are weak from going without food. My body is thin and bony.
I have become a joke to my accusers. When they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, LORD my God. Save me because of your faithful love.
Let them know that it is your hand, that you, LORD, have done it.
They may curse, but you will bless. When they attack, they will be put to shame, but I, your servant, will be glad.
Let my accusers be dressed in disgrace. Let them wrap themselves in shame like a robe.
With my mouth I will greatly thank the LORD. I will praise him in front of the great crowd.
He stands at the right side of those in need, to save them from those who would condemn them.
